children: The shares of Aurobindo Pharma have slumped nearly 2% after the pharma company announced that the USFDA has issued a Form 483 for the API manufacturing facility of its subsidiary with a VAI, or Voluntary Action Indicated, classification.

In an exchange filing issued on Wednesday, November 11, the Hyderabad-based company said the United States Food and Drug Administration (USFDA) inspected Unit-II, an API manufacturing facility of Apitoria Pharma Private Limited. Here, Apitoria Pharma Private Limited is a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, situated at Gaddapotharam, in Sangareddy District of Telangana.
The US drug regulator conducted its inspection from September 7th to September 15th, 2026.
What does 'Voluntary Action Indicated' classification mean?

The company added that the facility has received an Establishment Inspection Report (EIR) classifying the facility as "Voluntary Action Indicated" ("VAI"). FDA has concluded that this inspection is closed under 21 CFR 20.64(d)(3).
As per the USFDA, Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI) means objectionable conditions or practices were found, but the USFDA is not prepared to take or recommend any administrative or regulatory action.
The company reported its results for Q2FY27 last week on November 4, the pharma company reported a 32.8% year-on-year increase in consolidated net profit to ₹1,126 crore.

The pharmaceutical company also reported its highest-ever quarterly revenue from operations at ₹10,263 crore. This marked a 23.9% jump in the top-line figures, compared to the previous year's ₹8,286 crore.
Meanwhile, the Earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation (EBITDA) rose 28.4% year on year to ₹2,155 crore, compared with ₹1,678 crore in Q2FY26.

When we look at the company's shares, the stock has slipped in trade, falling over 1.50% intraday. However, the larger picture looks more positive for the stock, as the pharma company's shares have risen by 7% in the month's trade and have jumped over 50% this year so far.

Earlier in the day, the stock hit a new 52-week high of ₹1,859.90, slipping over 1.7% from there. The stock is trading 65.16% above its 52-week low of ₹1,106.00.10. The stock has broken a major 12-day winning streak to fall to a share price of ₹1,824 per share.

title: Aurobindo Pharma snaps 12-day winning streak after USFDA update on subsidiary's API unit
